items.title: F&O: Analyst recommends Bull spread strategy on Hero MotoCorp, PNB
items.description: Nandish Shah, deputy vice president, HDFC Securities, has recommended a bull spread strategy on Hero MotoCorp and Punjab National Bank.

items.title: Stock Market LIVE: GIFT Nifty falls 100pts; Kospi drops 9%, triggers circuit breaker on tech selloff
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Friday: The GIFT Nifty indicated a gap-down open for the Nifty50 index. Asian markets fell sharply as investors exited technology shares

items.title: Asian markets crash as AI rout rocks US markets, Kospi plunges 8%
items.description: South Korea's KOSPI triggered a circuit breaker after falling over 8 per cent, while Japan's Nikkei slid 6 per cent as concerns over AI spending and US political uncertainty rattled global markets

items.title: Sensex up 6,064 pts in six days; eyes strongest pre-Diwali rally in 35 yrs
items.description: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty rallied 8.3% and 8.1% in the last six trading sessions, and are on course to log the best 7-day pre-Diwali rally since the inception of Muhurat trading on the NSE in 1992.

items.title: Listed REITs beat Nifty over 2 years: Better bet than dividend stocks?
items.description: According to data available on ACE Equity till November 4, REITs' performance has been mixed across year-to-date, one-year, and two-year, but has largely managed to beat the benchmark Nifty.
